title: LSA: Fix TrustedAccessMask dissection for rename
description:
DomainAccessMask was renamed to TrustedAccessMask in
69f04acd3d59c7cbbe9c2bfdebf49268ae668324
but the MANUAL and HF_FIELD commands in the conformance file wasn't
updated for the rename and then later the code for the manual dissection
was removed as unused:
40ce96dc1bbe7a6b4c122cafa5d71e3876fbde75

Restore it by using the new name. Prevents a warning
        lsa.cnf:35: warning: hf field `hf_lsarpc_domain_access_mask' not used
